label: Town of Warren
header:
# Town of Warren municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Warren, Select Board page (warrenvt.org): lists the current board -- Devin Klein Corrigan (Chair), Harvey Blake, Joel Taplin, and Jeremiah Kemp -- four members of a five-seat board; the fifth seat is VACANT. The June 2026 Secretary of State directory's Camilla Behn is stale. J Kenneth Scott was the printed candidate for a two-year seat on the March 2026 ballot but is not on the current board; the vacancy sequence is unpublished and Scott is minted only as a Justice of the Peace (disclosed on #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Warren elects the clerk for a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Brent Adams as Warren's Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Brent Adams as Warren's Town Clerk. No clerk race appeared on the 2026 ballot (the three-year term did not stand)

Town of Warren, 2026 Town Meeting combined warnings and sample ballot (official): Patricia Begin is the sole printed candidate for Town Treasurer (three-year term). She succeeds Dayna Lisaius, whom the Secretary of State's Guide still lists (stale). Ballot + spreadsheet concurrence mint, disclosed on #163
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Patricia Begin as Warren's Town Treasurer
Town of Warren, 2026 Town Meeting combined warnings and sample ballot (official): the 2026 moderator race was write-in only and the winner is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Town of Warren, 2023 Town Report, officers pages: fixes the Board of Listers at three seats on three-year terms, but its roster is fully expired (2023/2024/2025)

Town of Warren, 2026 Town Meeting combined warnings and sample ballot (official): the 2026 sole printed lister candidate, Carolyn C. Adams, has no incumbency or published-outcome evidence -- straggler sweep; the post is created without memberships
Town of Warren, 2023 Town Report: fixes the Cemetery Commission at five seats on five-year terms and lists Jeff Campbell to 2026

Town of Warren, 2026 Town Meeting combined warnings and sample ballot (official): Campbell was the sole printed candidate for the seat in 2026. Minted under the disclosed sole-candidate + incumbency exception (#163). The other four seats' 2024/2025 winners are unpublished -- stragglers
Town of Warren, 2023 Town Report: fixes the library board at five seats on three-year terms (the ballot styles the office 'Library Commission') and lists David Ellison

Town of Warren, 2026 Town Meeting combined warnings and sample ballot (official): Ellison was the sole printed candidate for one of the two 2026 seats, for a second consecutive cycle. Minted under the disclosed sole-candidate + incumbency exception (#163). The second seat's printed candidate has no incumbency evidence and no published outcome -- not minted

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the five winners of Warren's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for five): J Kenneth Scott, Margaret Bullock Wade, Susan K Bauchner, Joni Zweig, and Sandra L Brodeur. All five remain in office
